UI consistency audit complete. Working tree clean, build passes (`vite build` exit 0, 7.85s).

## Audits 1–7: all PASS, zero new visual defects

Four batched Playwright sweeps (16 routes aggregated in-page per call) plus three source-level set differences:

| Audit | Result |
|---|---|
| **1 Icons** | 43/43 imports are `24/outline`; 0 solid, 0 foreign library, 0 `fa-*`. Only non-Heroicon `<svg>` are 6 `recharts-surface` on `/reports`. The 5 SVGs measuring 0×0 on every route are the mobile-only `bottom-tab-bar`. |
| **2 Buttons** | `.auth-btn` identical on 9/9 primary create buttons (36px / `0 24px` / 13px / `14px / 12px` / w700). `.quick-action-btn` = 53 base + 8 variants; every variant is an active/inactive state or a semantic colour. |
| **3 Headers** | `.topbar.glass` **56px on 16/16**, `<h1>` on 16/16. |
| **4 Sidebar** | `.nav-link` 42px uniform, exactly one `.is-active` (except the known orphan `/alerts`). |
| **5 Forms** | **0 native `<select>`, 0 native `<input type=date>`** across 16 routes + 4 modals. |
| **6 Spacing** | Panel gaps 12px (11) / 16px (9) + 4 contextual one-offs. |
| **7 Modals** | All 4 opened modals carry `modal-scale-in`; backdrop blur variance is the documented per-context pattern. |

Every outlier resolved to an active/inactive state, a documented deliberate variant, or the existing known-issues list. Full table in `docs/ui-audit-2026-08-19.md`.

## The stage's real finding

`git status` at the start showed **uncommitted work s2 left in the tree when it hit `max_turns`** — a complete, correct 4-defect contract-builder fix. I verified its claims against `contractService.js` and committed it as `8a5fd0d`:

- `POST /api/crm/contracts` read camelCase while its only caller sends snake_case → **every "Save Draft" 400'd** with `lead_id is required` while a valid `lead_id` sat in the body
- `customer_*` sent at the top level, but contracts have no such columns and the whitelist is `lead_id/estimate_id/template_type/content` → all four silently dropped
- Edit-hydration read those same absent columns → reopening a contract always showed blank customer fields
- Template picker read `contract.template_id`; a contract records `template_type` → every save filed as `standard`

## Three new set differences — run, clean, closed

Props-passed-vs-destructured (194 components), form-bound state never read (93 vars), and **client payload keys vs the server `allowedFields` whitelist extended to every remaining entity** — subcontractors, expenses, tasks, invoices, work orders, leads and tenant-settings all match exactly. All 4 prop hits were same-name component collisions across files, now recorded as a standing trap.

## Two things I did not do

- **The QA fuzz cleanup is still undone — now deferred eleven stages** on the production Neon free tier. It's a DB-write task outside this stage's charter; I flagged it as the next run's first action rather than spending UI-audit budget on it.
- **`MobileTaskSection` passes Material Icons ligature names** (`priority_high`, `today`, `calendar_month`) that it destructures and never renders, hardcoding one clipboard icon and dropping `iconColor`. A real icon-rule violation, but it sits inside the `if (isMobile)` branch and mobile is paused — documented, not changed.

Commits: `8a5fd0d` (fix), `4ae1238` (results archive). Memory resume and standing gotchas updated.
